newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese-ruled Hong Kong now a little bit bigger.
newsitem.headline: Chinese-ruled Hong Kong now a little bit bigger.

text.p: Hong Kong has literally outgrown its colonial status.

Under an order of China's State Council, or cabinet, Hong Kong's official boundaries have been redrawn as the former British colony begins its life as a Special Administrative Region of China, an official with the State Bureau of Surveying and Cartography said on Wednesday.

The order has extended Hong Kong's southwest border by one nautical mile and redrawn the northeastern boundary to include the island of Pingzhou, formerly a part of Guangdong province, said bureau spokesman Xing Shaohua.
"The extension will benefit Hong Kong's management over boats on the sea and over sea transportation in Hong Kong," Xing said without giving details.
Xing declined to say how much total area had been added to Hong Kong, which returned to Chinese sovereignty on Tuesday after 156 years of British colonial rule.
